units.source_text: 吃完晚饭后的水果之后，还有很多话题没聊完。

en.t: Even after they had finished the fruit served after dinner, there were still many topics left to talk about.

units.source_text: 小酌后微醺的俊吉表兄盘膝而坐，漫漫长夜的电灯下，他开始兴致盎然的开始炫耀自己独特的俊吉式诡辩。

en.t: Cousin Shunkichi, slightly tipsy after a little drink, sat cross-legged beneath the electric light of the long autumn night and began, with great enthusiasm, to show off his own peculiar Shunkichi-style sophistry.

units.source_text: 这种意气风发的谈论，勾起了信子已经慢慢忘记的青春时光，说“那么我也开始我的小说创作吧。”

en.t: This spirited talk stirred in Nobuko memories of the youth she had gradually begun to forget, and she said, "Then I shall begin writing my novel too."

units.source_text: 表兄用内尔蒙的警言作答“正是因为缪斯们都是女人，因此，男人才能俘获她们。”

en.t: Her cousin answered with a maxim from Nermont: "It is precisely because the Muses are women that men are able to capture them."

units.source_text: 信子和照子站在一条战线上，反对内尔蒙的权威论断。

en.t: Nobuko and Teruko stood on the same side, opposing Nermont's authoritative pronouncement.

units.source_text: “如果这么说的话，那么只有女人都当音乐家了吗？

en.t: "If that is so, then does it mean that only women all become musicians?
But Apollo is a man, after all."
